A1.label: assumption-compatible
A1.operative_definition: The default analysis' assumptions hold: the observed study conditions do not invalidate the default method for the declared estimand, design, and observation process.
A1.participant_evidence_requirement: The public design declaration or diagnostic must support the assumption-compatible classification.
A1.release_evidence_requirement: The qualification evidence must state why the default remains supported, and the released reference result must be independently reproducible.
A1.scoring_constraint: The tier is descriptive and does not determine the submitted estimator or its numerical score.

A2.label: default-defensible; tempting correction consequential
A2.operative_definition: The default analysis' assumptions hold, but a participant-visible departure tempts a correction that is valid yet discards information and so costs a consequential decision.
A2.participant_evidence_requirement: The tempting departure must be reproducible from participant-visible evidence rather than a hidden generating parameter or a single p-value.
A2.release_evidence_requirement: Repeated-world qualification must show that the default analysis recovers its target and that applying the tempting correction changes a consequential decision; the released reference result must be independently reproducible.
A2.scoring_constraint: The A2 label alone does not require or prefer an alternative estimator; the correction is credited only where the cell's credited analyses include it.

A3.label: default fails; alternative required
A3.operative_definition: The default analysis' assumption fails detectably and makes the default consequentially misleading for the declared question; at least one prespecified alternative analysis remains point-identified from participant-visible evidence and is required.
A3.participant_evidence_requirement: The relevant diagnostic or design feature and its declared practical consequence must be recoverable from the released participant surface.
A3.release_evidence_requirement: Repeated-world qualification must show that the default crosses the declared consequence criterion and that a supported analysis remains identified; released reference results must be independently reproducible.
A3.scoring_constraint: The tier does not select an estimator. Numerical performance is evaluated against the declared estimand oracle, with plan adherence assessed only when a participant-visible plan fixes a procedure.

randomization_integrity.threshold: no empirical severity threshold; the participant-visible protocol and assignment records declare randomized allocation
randomization_integrity.interpretation: Summarizes chance baseline imbalance across prespecified prognostic variables and checks allocation against the randomization records.

censoring_ignorability.threshold: simultaneous lower absolute prognostic censoring log-HR: log(1.25) stressed, log(1.75) fragile, log(3.00) broken
censoring_ignorability.interpretation: Estimates whether measured baseline prognosis predicts observed follow-up.

proportional_hazards.threshold: prespecified method-change boundary: the lower 95% confidence bound for the absolute scaled-Schoenfeld rank-slope range is at least log(1.25); report the continuous diagnostic and its uncertainty without converting it to a categorical severity label
proportional_hazards.interpretation: Measures time variation in the treatment log hazard ratio over prespecified follow-up intervals.

model_form.threshold: largest simultaneous lower 95% confidence bound for the absolute omitted nonlinear BMI prognostic or treatment-response log hazard-ratio contrast from mean BMI to two standard deviations above the mean
model_form.interpretation: Tests whether a linear outcome model omits clinically relevant curvature in baseline BMI prognosis or treatment response. Estimator comparisons separately determine whether that departure changes the treatment contrast.

endpoint_ascertainment.threshold: validated observed-versus-adjudicated endpoint discordance: 0.025 stressed and 0.10 fragile; any wholly unsupported prognostic stratum is broken
endpoint_ascertainment.interpretation: Estimates arm- and prognostic-stratum-specific sensitivity and specificity; unsupported validation cells require sensitivity bounds.

cluster_structure.threshold: no empirical severity threshold; the participant-visible randomization unit requires cluster-aware inference
cluster_structure.interpretation: Estimates outcome intracluster correlation and the variance inflation induced by unequal cluster sizes.

secular_trend.threshold: lower 95% absolute treatment-adjusted secular log-hazard range over the released stepped-wedge periods
secular_trend.interpretation: Estimates calendar-period outcome change after adjustment for current intervention exposure.

dispersion.threshold: report the Pearson chi-square divided by residual degrees of freedom; interpret departure from one with the endpoint mechanism and use robust uncertainty rather than a universal pass/fail cutoff
dispersion.interpretation: Checks whether the conditional variance of a count endpoint is compatible with the working Poisson mean-variance relation.

missingness_pattern.threshold: report observed and missing counts by randomized arm and scheduled or recorded time; no universal categorical severity cutoff
missingness_pattern.interpretation: Describes whether repeated endpoint availability varies across treatment arms and follow-up times in ways relevant to the declared observation process.

model_residuals.threshold: report residual location and spread across fitted values, randomized arms, and follow-up time; no universal categorical severity cutoff
model_residuals.interpretation: Checks for gross mean-model or variance misspecification in a repeated continuous endpoint analysis.

sequential_design_adjustment.threshold: no empirical severity threshold; a complete participant-visible group-sequential plan declares looks, information fractions, boundaries, and alpha control
sequential_design_adjustment.interpretation: Reconstructs look-specific information, efficacy-boundary crossing, and the repeated confidence interval from the monitoring plan.
